# unraid_server (Data Source)

Identity of the Unraid server. Requires `READ_ANY` on `SERVERS`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "unraid_server" "this" {}

output "server_name" {
  value = data.unraid_server.this.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `comment` (String) Server description.
- `guid` (String) Flash drive GUID.
- `id` (String) Server identifier.
- `lan_ip` (String) LAN IP address.
- `local_url` (String) Local URL of the web UI.
- `name` (String) Server name.
- `status` (String) Connect status: `ONLINE`, `OFFLINE` or `NEVER_CONNECTED`.
